label: QMilch
note: Modern German fibre (Anke Domaske) made from dairy-waste milk; the maker says it uses no harsh chemicals, unlike the Lanital-type fibres hardened in formaldehyde (company statement)

about.text: Qmilch is a modern German milk fibre developed by Anke Domaske, made from German dairy waste milk that cannot be sold. The maker says the process is free of harsh chemicals ("so natural you can eat it"), unlike older casein fibres that were hardened with formaldehyde; this rests on the company's own statements.

facts.v: No dissolving in alkali and no acid or formaldehyde bath is described; the maker says it uses no harsh chemicals (company claim, not independently confirmed)
